node: Student loan servicing and education payments
summary: Expanded the universe around the underfollowed operating rails beneath education finance: federal/private student-loan servicing, education payment processing, tuition/payment software, and regulated servicing transitions. The strongest direct public-market mappings are Nelnet, Maximus/Aidvantage, Flywire, and Navient. Nelnet is the cleanest direct exposure because it reports both Loan Servicing and Systems and Education Technology Services and Payments segments. Maximus is a less obvious government-services name with Aidvantage exposure. Flywire is the education-payments specialist rather than a loan servicer. Navient is a speculative shadow candidate because it retains education-lending/portfolio exposure but has materially impaired federal-servicing optionality after regulatory actions.
